authoritative_plan.path: FOMC_決策記憶系統_Hackathon_MVP_開發計畫_R5.docx

proxy_interpretation: Moody's seasoned Baa corporate bond yield spread is used as a narrow, observable credit-conditions proxy for the Hackathon reaction model; it is not represented as the broad Chicago Fed NFCI.
rerun_rationale: The approved contract documents the already frozen v1 feature set and does not change model weights, prompts, schemas, case inputs, or model-bundle hashes.
required_disclosure: The Hackathon reaction model uses BAA10Y as a narrow credit-conditions proxy, not NFCI and not a complete measure of financial conditions.
boundaries: Approval applies only to the Hackathon R5 lineage.
The proxy decision does not establish statistical superiority or production suitability.
Production model selection must compare BAA10Y and NFCI under a separately frozen evaluation contract.
Results from a future NFCI model must not be mixed with this BAA10Y lineage.
